ana: Heads-up — I merged quant-v4 kernel to staging at ~01:00PT and kicked the night-bucket canary. Seeing warmstart failures on ~A100-24 nodes (low but consistent). Logs pasted below.

ana: ```
ERROR: warmstart failed: kv-cache-init timeout (gpu=0)
stack: runtime::kv_cache::init -> matmul::load_weights -> quant::dequantize
metric: warmstart_failure_rate=0.032
``` 

ben: Reproduced locally on an A100-24 repro VM. Failing during kv cache load when sequence_len>1024. Trying a quick recompile with relaxed prefetch.

deploy-bot: pinned quant-v4-kernel -> quant-v3-kernel for region=us-west2-night; reason="warmstart regression observed". pin_id=pin-2026-03-21-01

sam: Good call. Can we extend the night-bucket smoke window by +2h and run the long warmstart perf sweep (seq_len 2048/4096)?

ana: Yes. Also adding thermal-backstop label to the rolling group so ops will quarantine if OOMs spike.

jamie: For release notes: note a "known warmstart regression on some A100-24 SKUs" and recommended mitigation is pinned fallback (quant-v3-kernel). I'll draft the blurb and post for approvals.

ben: If pin doesn't cover other regions, we should run a quick canary across eu-west and ap-south with the fallback. I'll queue today’s smoke matrix.

deploy-bot: scheduled extended-smoke -> job=warmstart-sweep-20260321-01 (ETA 45m). Notification will post to #eng-runtime when done.

ana: Decision: hold progressive rollout for 2h, run full warmstart matrix. If warmstart_failure_rate > 0.01 for >15m on any region, trigger rollback to quant-v3-kernel and notify infra.

sam: Acknowledged. I'll monitor dashboards and tag ops-oncall if thermal/backpressure appears. :eyes:

jamie: I'll add the release note and record the pin id and rollback criteria in the release ticket.

ben: Working on a dev patch to guard kv-cache init; will push an experimental build to staging once tests pass.

ana: Thanks all — keep updates in this thread. If anyone sees a regression outside night-bucket ping here immediately.
